This mechanism prevents failures in one component or service from propagating to dependent components, thereby protecting the overall system stability and ensuring that decode lanes remain responsive even when new prompts are prefilling or other components are experiencing issues.

Transaction isolation controls the degree to which the operations of one database transaction are visible to or affected by concurrent transactions. It specifically governs the handling of concurrency anomalies such as dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, and phantom reads, ensuring that concurrent access to shared data maintains consistency and integrity according to defined rules.
